answer_4.quote: We investigate the complexity of differentiating the language model used for creating machine-generated texts for human readers. [...] Annotator background. Group 1, 2, 3, and 4 are annotated by native Italian, Chinese, English, and Russian speakers, respectively; they are either postdoc or PhD students in NLP.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators performed a four-class classification task to identify the generator of the text, with five-shot demonstration examples for learning.
